meta.title: Handimen — Share what you have
meta.description: Share tools, equipment, and skills with your neighbours in Poblenou.

home.title: Share tools, equipment and skills with your neighbours
home.subtitle: A neighbourhood network for lending what you already own — for free or for a small fee. Borrow a drill, rent a cargo bike, or ask for a hand.

feed.title: What's happening in Poblenou
feed.subtitle: Neighbours asking for a hand, sharing what they just lent, and tips for the block.

explore.title: Explore the neighbourhood
explore.subtitle: Filter what neighbours are lending nearby.

map.title: The neighbourhood map
map.subtitle: A stylized view of Poblenou. Tap a pin to see what's there.

request.title: Request to borrow
request.subtitle: Pick your dates and send a short message to the owner.
request.messagePlaceholder: Hi! I'd need it this weekend for a small moving job.
request.escrowNote: Payment is simulated in this demo — the escrow flow is real, the money is not.

newListing.title: List something
newListing.subtitle: Share a tool, a piece of equipment, or a skill with the neighbourhood.
newListing.pickupHint: Simulated for now — listings appear near the centre of Poblenou.

errors.invalid_fields: Add a title (3+ characters) and a description.
errors.verify_email: Verify your email before listing something.
errors.phone_required_for_paid: Verify your phone to list a paid rental (deposits under €50).
errors.id_required_for_high_deposit: Verify your identity to list a rental with a deposit of €50 or more.
errors.not_allowed: You can't publish this listing yet.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.trustSubtitle: Verification scales with risk, so we only ask for what's needed.
profile.verifyPhoneNote: In production this sends a one-time code by SMS.
profile.verifyIdentityNote: In production this would be an ID document check (Stripe Identity).
profile.seedNote: Creates a starter listing plus an incoming request from a neighbour, so you can try the borrow flow.
profile.signInTitle: Sign in to see your profile
profile.signInBody: Your trust level, reviews and listings live behind a magic-link sign-in.

messages.title: Messages
messages.empty: No conversations yet. Message a neighbour from any listing.

review.leaveSubtitle: How did the handoff go? Reviews keep the neighbourhood trustworthy.
review.commentPlaceholder: Tell the neighbourhood how it went…

signIn.title: Sign in to Handimen
signIn.subtitle: We'll email you a magic link. No password needed.
signIn.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device.
signIn.error: We couldn't send the link. Please try again.
